def dt_format_to_regex(fmt):
    regex_parts = []
    i = 0
    while i < len(fmt):
        if fmt[i] == '%':
            if i+1 >= len(fmt):
                raise ValueError('incomplete format directive at end')
            directive = fmt[i:i+2]
            if directive in directive_map:
                regex_parts.append(directive_map[directive])
                i += 2
                continue
            else:
                raise ValueError(f'Unsupported datetime format code {directive}')
        else:
            regex_parts.append(re.escape(fmt[i]))
            i += 1
    return ''.join(regex_parts)
